free_tier.stated: Unlimited Traffic on the free CDN (Basic Plan / Free), subject to a fair-use policy. Arvancloud's own catalogue also lists object storage and traffic free. The former monthly traffic figure is no longer stated on the first-party free-tier page.

per_object_cap.stated: stated-absent: the cited report states no per-object size cap

retention.stated: stated-absent: the cited report states no retention period for stored bytes

egress.terms: Free 100GB of traffic per month, with an unlimited number of requests, per the cited report.

record.interface_detail: stated-absent: the cited report describes a CDN service with page rules and firewall rules and states no storage client interface
record.chaining: stated-absent: the cited report states no way to chain the CDN into a byte store; it describes traffic and page/firewall rules
record.reliability_note: Free CDN tier is 100 GB/month of traffic, per a LowEndTalk report and their own catalogue entries. A third of Gcore's free slice and with far worse latency outside the region. Also a genuin.
record.confidence_note: Rejection quoted from historical research records; unverified against live endpoints.
